name: Star Health and Allied Insurance Company Limited
summary: Star Health and Allied Insurance Company Limited provides health insurance products in India. It offers retail health insurance products for individuals and families; group health insurance products for employer/employee and non-employer/employee groups, including small-to-medium enterprises; and personal accident and travel insurance products. The company also provides star women care insurance policy that provides surrogacy and oocyte donor covers; and star special care product that covers children diagnosed with autism and for outpatient specialized treatments.
